title: Exact module comparison data and compatible adjoint squares
statement: For small ringed sites with coefficient ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-topos, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-pbc-ringed-presentation-comparison-data], BinaryPresentationModules(g) records an equivalence of their module sheaf categories with additive, finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation in both directions, its underlying inverse-image comparison, rank-one comparison with the structural-map equation, inverse isomorphic to the specified module direct image, and its termwise induced ordinary derived equivalence. BinaryPresentationAdjointSquare records an invertible restriction square and invertibility of both its actual adjunction mates for arbitrary specified adjoints. These are exactly the two definitions formerly in BinaryCoverSitePresentation; all fields and universes are unchanged.
